description: Gammapy analyzes gamma-ray data and creates sky images, spectra and lightcurves, from event lists and instrument response information; it can also determine the position, morphology and spectra of gamma-ray sources. It is used to analyze data from H.E.S.S., Fermi-LAT, HAWC, and the Cherenkov Telescope Array Observatory(CTAO).
title: Gammapy: Python toolbox for gamma-ray astronomy
